verified_by: 3-state differential (Maven 3.9.11, JDK 11) on a clean clone of voyanttools/trombone, with an INVARIANT driver test

discovery.found_by: bbc_e2e.py run (32-term deep mine, 2026-08-06) -> classify -> verify_traversal

behavioral_break.why_it_breaks: saveFlexibleParameters / loadFlexibleParameters each built a bare `new XStream()` and round-tripped the parameters object to and from a file. From 1.4.18 XStream denies all types by default, so loading a file the same code had just written refuses FlexibleParameters at run time. Compiles unchanged against 1.4.18.
behavioral_break.driver_note: trombone's src/test tree holds only EmbeddedWebServer and TestHelper -- no test covers this round trip. Hence an authored driver calling only the two existing public production methods.

adaptation.the_call: private static XStream secureXStream(XStream xs): addPermission(NoTypePermission.NONE) + NullPermission.NULL + PrimitiveTypePermission.PRIMITIVES + allowTypeHierarchy(Collection/Map) + allowTypes({FlexibleParameters.class, String.class}) + allowTypesByWildcard({"org.voyanttools.trombone.**"})
adaptation.summary: Introduce a secureXStream(...) helper and route both round-trip sites through it, replacing bare `new XStream()`. Explicitly resets to deny-all then re-permits primitives, collections, maps and the project's own package tree. ToolSerializer gets the equivalent allowlist inline.

traversal.note: The bump landed one commit BEFORE the adaptation, so the parent commit already declares 1.4.18. Establishing the pre-boundary baseline therefore required explicitly downgrading the parent to 1.4.16 for state 1 -- see the verification note.

verification.method: Clean clone; single driver test via -Dtest=BbcDifferentialTest. JDK 11. Local repo -Dmaven.repo.local=C:/bump-p4p/.bbc_m2.
verification.baseline_construction_note: IMPORTANT: unlike the bundled-bump cases, the parent here is ALREADY at 1.4.18 (post-merge-fix shape). State 1 is therefore the parent source with the pom explicitly downgraded to 1.4.16 -- a reconstructed pre-boundary baseline, not a commit that exists in the repo's history. This is legitimate for establishing that the same source passes below the boundary and fails above it, but it is a reconstruction and is recorded as such.
verification.driver_invariance: The same BbcDifferentialTest.java source was present unmodified in all three states, carried across the checkout by copy.

states.name: 2_new_lib_old_code
states.config: parent code (d03c1237) + xstream 1.4.18 (as the parent declares)

verification.conclusion: Confirmed behavioural break with a production-side adaptation. A parameters file round trip that succeeds at 1.4.16 is refused at 1.4.18 with otherwise-unchanged code, and routing both sites through secureXStream(...) restores it. Driver invariant across all three states.
